expectations.text: Includes QC 1000 awareness: effective December 15, 2026 for audit firms
expectations.evidence: "QC 1000 becomes effective for audit firms on December 15, 2026, so your auditor may adjust processes."

expectations.text: Uses the October 22, 2026 PCAOB Spotlight on 2025 inspections to anticipate auditor focus areas
expectations.evidence: No mention of the October 22, 2026 Spotlight or the 2025 inspection results anywhere in the response.

expectations.text: Covers the core ITGC domains (access, change management, IT operations)
expectations.evidence: Dedicated sections 3 "Change management," 4 "Access management," and 5 "IT operations."

expectations.text: States the current 404(b) framework applies because the SEC proposal has seen no final action
expectations.evidence: The SEC's 404(b) proposal and its status are never mentioned; the response only says "Verify the status of any SEC or PCAOB changes before the audit."

expectations.text: Ties recommendations to correct dates rather than invented deadlines
expectations.evidence: The dates given are accurate (QC 1000 effective December 15, 2026; AS 1105/AS 2301 technology amendments effective for fiscal years beginning on or after December 15, 2025); no invented deadlines.
